source_rehash_history.reason: model_builder.FOOTPRINT_RANGE is now derived from DEFAULT_BUILD_CONFIG.geometry instead of restating a literal (50.0, 5000.0)
source_rehash_history.why_it_was_needed: the footprint ceiling was raised from 5 000 to 20 000 m2 on 2026-08-03. At 5 000 the gate excluded 123 Valencia buildings carrying 11.55 % of the city's floor area, so a city total silently stood for 87.5 % of the stock; the new ceiling brings area coverage to 98.38 %. The constant was dead code - the real gate in prepare_footprint() reads the config - so leaving it would have parked a wrong (50, 5000) two lines above the working gate
source_rehash_history.physics_unchanged: verified_model --verify 13/13 PASS with every gate bit-identical to the previous golden: residential area 954.800, wall U 1.409, people 73.530, heating 26.527, cooling -68.403, total site 53.680 kWh/m2. Rai's replica is 954.8 m2, far from either ceiling, so no gate could move
source_rehash_history.workbench_unaffected: the ceiling is a BuildConfig field the UI already exposes and validates (ConfigPanel footprint_max_m2); no adapter, scenario or LHS code path changed, and the frontend suite passes 51/51
source_rehash_history.no_result_invalidated: no committed run is rewritten. Past runs stay on the profile they were produced under; the new ceiling only changes which buildings a FUTURE run admits
